chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Abdullah ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from al-Ala ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Hamza al-Thumali who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said to me: 'Become a scholar, or a student (of knowledge), or love the people of knowledge, but do not become a fourth (type), so you would be destroyed by their hatred.'

key_terms.أَهْلَ الْعِلْمِ: People of knowledge — scholars and learned authorities
key_terms.اغْدُ: Become, wake up as — an imperative from the root gh-d-w (morning), often used idiomatically to mean 'let yourself be'
key_terms.بُغْضِهِمْ: Hatred/aversion toward them (the people of knowledge)
key_terms.رَابِعاً: A fourth (type) — the unnamed fourth category is the one who neither learns, nor studies, nor loves scholars
key_terms.مُتَعَلِّماً: Student, one who is actively acquiring knowledge

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Sadiq say about one's relationship to knowledge and scholars?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him), speaking personally to his companion Abu Hamza al-Thumali, enjoined him to adopt one of three positive relationships to religious knowledge: to be a scholar, a learner, or at minimum a sincere lover of scholars. The warning against being a 'fourth type' — one who harbors hatred or indifference toward scholars — resonated deeply in a community where the transmission of Islamic learning was existential. Historical context: this teaching was likely delivered in the setting of Imam al-Sadiq's scholarly circle in Medina during the Abbasid era, when the Imam was training hundreds of students to preserve and transmit Shia jurisprudence.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Abdullah Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Al A’ala Bin Razeyn, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, from Abu Hamza Al Sumaly who said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘Become a scholar, or a student, or love the people of knowledge, but do not become a fourth (type), so you would be destroyed by their hatred’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from ‘Abdallah ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from al-‘Ala’ ibn Razin from Muhammad ibn Muslim from abu Hamza al-Thumali who has said the following.

“Abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) said this. ‘It is narrated from Imam abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said, “Be a scholar or a learning person or love the scholars. Do not become of the fourth group lest you will be destroyed by their hatred.’”
